description:
## Failure

Found verifying bedrock-3t9 (PR #323) in the 3-node harness with desired_logs 3 (one log per node). kill -9 a follower hosting a log: the commit proxy fails, the director restarts recovery and stalls on `{:insufficient_nodes, 3, 2}` (expected — three new logs need three live nodes). Restart the node: it re-registers (coordinator shows its capabilities and services), but the director never attempts recovery again. Observed stuck for minutes; cluster unavailable though all three nodes are up.

## Mechanism (origin/develop 3af051c2)

- `Coordinator.State.Changes.convert_to_capability_map/1` (coordinator/state.ex:170-183) filters each capability's nodes by `Node.ping(&1) == :pong` when building the map handed to the director. The dead node is dropped from the director's view.
- The coordinator's own `node_capabilities` still contains the node (nothing removes it on nodedown).
- On return, `Durability.process_command({:set_node_resources, ...})` (coordinator/durability.ex) computes `capabilities_changed = current != new` against the coordinator's unfiltered map -> false; restarted workers keep the same id and `{otp_name, node}` ref -> not new_or_changed. So `notify_director_of_resource_changes/4` sends nothing, and `Director.Server.try_to_recover_if_stalled/1` never runs.

Also note: `Node.ping/1` runs inside the coordinator GenServer (the raft driver) for every capability node; against an unreachable non-loopback host it can block for net_setuptime.

## Expected

A stalled recovery waiting on nodes must be woken when a node it excluded becomes available again. Liveness should not be a one-shot snapshot that the change detector compares against a different (unfiltered) map.

comments.text: Related trigger seen during bedrock-w10 verification: Foreman.advertise_running_worker/2 (service/foreman/impl.ex ~170-190) registers via Link.fetch_coordinator -> Coordinator.register_services, ignoring errors; when the Link is pinned to a non-leader coordinator (bedrock-v65, PR #282 unmerged) the registration is dropped and never retried, so a log recruited by one generation is invisible to the next leader's director.

title: [BUG] Stalled recovery never retries when a missing node returns: liveness is snapshotted by Node.ping at director launch and re-registration with unchanged capabilities notifies nobody
